cards.title: Selectors and combinators
cards.code:
.garden-card > h2 { margin-block-start: 0; }
input[type="email"] { border: 2px solid seagreen; }
cards.explanation: Style card titles and email inputs without relying on document-wide element rules.

cards.title: Cascade, inheritance and layers
cards.explanation: Give component styles a deliberate layer priority over baseline button styling.

cards.title: Box model and sizing
cards.code:
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.garden-card { max-inline-size: 32rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #94a3b8; margin-inline: auto; }
cards.explanation: Keep a padded card within a predictable maximum width and center it in its container.

cards.title: Units and calculated values
cards.code:
.page { inline-size: min(100% - 2rem, 70rem); margin-inline: auto; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem); }
cards.explanation: Bound the page width and scale its heading smoothly across viewport sizes.

cards.title: Colors and backgrounds
cards.code: .harvest-banner { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #14532d, #064e3b); padding: 1rem; }
cards.explanation: A dark gradient banner with a light foreground; verify contrast at both gradient endpoints.

cards.title: Typography and text flow
cards.explanation: Use system fonts, comfortable line spacing, and a bounded reading measure.

cards.title: Display and visibility
cards.code:
.tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; }
.archived { display: none; }
cards.explanation: Let a tag accept padding predictably while removing archived content from layout.

cards.title: Flexbox alignment
cards.code:
.toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center; }
.toolbar .search { flex: 1 1 14rem; min-inline-size: 0; }
cards.explanation: A toolbar wraps on narrow screens while giving the search field flexible space.

cards.title: Grid layouts
cards.code: .beds { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 16rem), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
cards.explanation: Create as many garden cards per row as fit, while permitting a single card to shrink below 16rem.

cards.title: Positioning and stacking
cards.code:
.garden-card { position: relative; padding: 1rem 4rem 1rem 1rem; }
.garden-card .badge { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 0.5rem; inset-inline-end: 0.5rem; }
cards.explanation: Anchor a badge to its card and reserve padding so it cannot cover the text.

cards.title: Overflow and clipping
cards.code:
.table-scroll { max-inline-size: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
.table-scroll table { min-inline-size: 28rem; }
cards.explanation: Wrap a data table in .table-scroll to keep the page narrow while preserving every column.

cards.title: Pseudo-classes and focus
cards.code:
.save:hover { background-color: #14532d; }
.save:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 3px; }
cards.explanation: Give pointer hover feedback and a separate clear focus indicator for keyboard navigation.

cards.title: Pseudo-elements
cards.code: .bed-name::after { content: ""; display: block; inline-size: 3rem; block-size: 0.2rem; background: seagreen; }
cards.explanation: Add a decorative underline that carries no essential information.

cards.title: Media queries and responsive layouts
cards.code:
.journal { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
@media (min-width: 48rem) { .journal { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; } }
cards.explanation: Stack the journal and sidebar by default and split them when the viewport has room.

cards.title: Container queries
cards.explanation: Place .bed-summary inside .bed-panel to adapt the summary to its panel width rather than the viewport.

cards.title: Custom properties and themes
cards.code:
:root { --garden-accent: #166534; --garden-space: 1rem; }
.garden-card { padding: var(--garden-space); border: 2px solid var(--garden-accent); }
cards.explanation: Share spacing and accent tokens across cards and override them in a subtree when needed.

cards.title: Transitions and transforms
cards.explanation: Lift an action slightly on hover and disable that motion when the user requests it.

cards.title: Keyframe animation
cards.explanation: Reveal a notice once with a short fade, with a reduced-motion opt-out.

cards.title: Bootstrap CSS customization
cards.explanation: Add garden-action to a Bootstrap 5.3 btn btn-primary button. These variables customize its default and hover colors.

cards.title: Tailwind build and theme tokens
cards.explanation: Tailwind 4 input stylesheet for bg-garden and font-journal utilities. Run the pinned playground build; do not link this input directly.

cards.title: Override a low-specificity component default
cards.code:
:where(.notice) { color: green; }
p { color: navy; }
cards.explanation: Use a p.notice paragraph. The zero specificity default yields to a type selector; :is() would retain its most specific argument. No dependency.

cards.title: Mark a form section containing invalid input
cards.explanation: Wrap a required email input in .field and keep its visible label. The border supplements native validation; it is not the only error message. :has support required.
keywords: mark a form section containing invalid input

cards.title: Opt one button out of a theme layer
cards.explanation: Attach action to two buttons, plain to one. Normal layers are ordered base then theme; revert-layer recovers the previous layer instead of erasing all author styling.
keywords: opt one button out of a theme layer

cards.title: Reset inherited text and noninherited spacing
cards.explanation: Place initial and unset spans plus a revert div inside .panel. initial resets color to its initial value; unset inherits color but resets margin. revert restores the user/UA origin for display.
keywords: reset inherited text and noninherited spacing

cards.title: Mirror a notice inset for RTL readers
cards.code: .notice { margin-inline-start: 20px; padding-inline-end: 8px; }
cards.explanation: Use a block .notice in an HTML container with dir=ltr or dir=rtl. Let document direction control logical spacing instead of maintaining left/right overrides.
keywords: mirror a notice inset for rtl readers

cards.title: Size a vertical reading label
cards.code: .label { writing-mode: vertical-rl; inline-size: 100px; block-size: 40px; padding-block-start: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; }
cards.explanation: Use a .label block. In vertical-rl the inline axis is vertical and block start is right; border-box includes padding in the measured dimensions.

cards.title: Keep a short badge fitted to its text
cards.code: .badge { width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 4px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
cards.explanation: Put a .badge block inside a constrained parent. Fit-content shrinks short labels, the maximum and wrapping keep long unbroken identifiers within the parent.
keywords: keep a short badge fitted to its text

cards.title: Bound a reading column and fluid heading
cards.explanation: Place h2 and aside inside .reader. The reader fills narrow parents up to 600px, the heading is bounded at both ends and the aside keeps a usable minimum.
keywords: bound a reading column and fluid heading

cards.title: Crop a landscape thumbnail without stretching
cards.code: .photo { display: block; width: 160px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }
cards.explanation: Use img.photo with alt text and a 200×100 source image. Auto height plus aspect-ratio reserves a square; cover crops horizontally. Keep important content away from crop edges.
keywords: crop a landscape thumbnail without stretching

cards.title: Show a whole logo inside a fixed slot
cards.code: .logo { display:block; width: 120px; height: 80px; object-fit: contain; background: #eee; }
cards.explanation: Use img.logo with alt text and a 200×100 image. Explicit box dimensions win over intrinsic dimensions; contain preserves the whole image with unused space.
keywords: show a whole logo inside a fixed slot

cards.title: Prevent a long flex title from overflowing
cards.explanation: Place .title and .action children inside .toolbar; keep the complete title accessible via expansion or a details view. min-width:0 removes the automatic min-content floor.
keywords: prevent a long flex title from overflowing

cards.title: Distribute flexible columns with different growth
cards.explanation: Use primary and secondary blocks in .row. With zero basis and no gap/border/padding their widths divide free space 2:1; a nonzero basis changes the calculation.
keywords: distribute flexible columns with different growth

cards.title: Fit a responsive gallery without a minimum-width trap
cards.code: .gallery { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 160px), 1fr)); gap:10px; }
cards.explanation: Use .gallery with three direct card children. Nested min prevents the track minimum exceeding a narrow container; auto-fit collapses unused tracks. DOM order stays reading order.
keywords: fit a responsive gallery without a minimum-width trap

cards.title: Align nested cards with a shared column grid
cards.code:
.catalog { display:grid; grid-template-columns:100px 200px; gap:10px; }
.record { display:grid; grid-column:1 / -1; grid-template-columns:subgrid; }
cards.explanation: Use .record children inside .catalog; each record contains a name and description. Requires column subgrid (asserted in pinned Chromium). Supply a separate fallback for older browsers.
keywords: align nested cards with a shared column grid

cards.title: Let a featured card span columns without dense reordering
cards.code:
.results { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 80px); grid-auto-rows:40px; gap:10px; }
.featured { grid-column:span 2; }
cards.explanation: Put a featured item before two ordinary .results children. Default sparse row auto-placement follows source order; avoid dense if reading and visual order would diverge.
keywords: let a featured card span columns without dense reordering

cards.title: Keep a high-z-index child under a sibling overlay
cards.explanation: Use .tooltip inside .component and .overlay as its sibling. The tooltip cannot outrank the overlay while its parent remains in the lower stacking context.
keywords: keep a high-z-index child under a sibling overlay

cards.title: Contain a decorative negative layer
cards.code:
.badge { isolation:isolate; position:relative; width:120px; height:50px; background:white; }
.badge::before { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; background:gold; }
cards.explanation: Use .badge around real text. Isolation creates a stacking context so a negative generated layer paints above the badge background while staying behind its content.

cards.title: Keep a section heading within its own scroll panel
cards.explanation: Put a .heading then .content inside .scroll. No outer scrolling dependency: the panel is the nearest scrolling ancestor. A solid background prevents text painting through the heading.
keywords: keep a section heading within its own scroll panel

cards.title: Freeze a leading table column in horizontal scroll
cards.explanation: Use a two-column table inside .table-scroll with th scope=row in each body row. Sticky is horizontal here; retain semantic headers and an obvious scroll affordance.
keywords: freeze a leading table column in horizontal scroll

cards.title: Clip decoration without creating a scroll container
cards.code:
.frame { width:100px; height:60px; overflow:clip; }
.decoration { width:200px; height:120px; }
cards.explanation: Use an oversized nonessential .decoration inside .frame. Clip prevents even programmatic scrolling; use auto for essential overflowing content instead.
keywords: clip decoration without creating a scroll container

cards.title: Wrap an unbroken identifier inside a narrow card
cards.code: .message { width:120px; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
cards.explanation: Use a .message block containing a long identifier. anywhere avoids horizontal overflow without inserting characters into copied DOM text.
keywords: wrap an unbroken identifier inside a narrow card

cards.title: Offer expansion for a truncated filename
cards.code:
.filename { width:140px; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
details[open] .filename { white-space:normal; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
cards.explanation: Put .filename inside details with a summary named Show full filename. The closed line is clipped; opening details reveals wrapped full text. Essential names remain real HTML text.
keywords: offer expansion for a truncated filename

cards.title: Scope an accent with a missing-token fallback
cards.code:
.card { color:var(--accent, navy); }
.special { --accent:green; }
cards.explanation: Use one ordinary .card and one .card.special. Unregistered custom properties inherit; an absent token selects the fallback without changing unrelated cards.
keywords: scope an accent with a missing-token fallback

cards.title: Stop decorative motion for reduced-motion users
cards.explanation: Use a nonessential .indicator beside real progress text. The media query disables motion without hiding status. Inspect animation state or seek its timeline instead of waiting.
keywords: stop decorative motion for reduced-motion users

cards.title: Keep focus and borders visible in forced colors
cards.explanation: Use a real button.control with a visible label. System colors survive forced-color adaptation; do not rely only on box shadows or disable forced-color adjustment. Verify contrast separately in chosen themes.
keywords: keep focus and borders visible in forced colors

cards.title: Number decorative section markers
cards.explanation: Put chapter headings with real text inside .manual. Counters decorate section headings; for meaningful ordered steps use ol/li instead. Counter scope resets per manual.

cards.title: Add a decorative required-field marker
cards.code:
.required::after { content:" *"; color:crimson; }
.required.optional::after { content:none; }
cards.explanation: Use label.required around a natively required input; keep the word required in visible HTML. Generated marker is supplemental. Add optional only after removing the actual required constraint.

cards.title: Transition only opacity on a disclosure
cards.explanation: Use .panel with an application-controlled open class. Opacity alone does not remove hidden content from focus or accessibility; application must also manage hidden/inert as appropriate. Test by seeking the transition.
keywords: transition only opacity on a disclosure

cards.title: Inspect a one-shot reveal at deterministic progress
cards.explanation: Use .notice with real status text. A one-shot animation retains its final frame; automated checks pause and seek the Web Animations timeline, never rely on elapsed sleeps.
keywords: inspect a one-shot reveal at deterministic progress

cards.title: Stack Bootstrap actions before a custom breakpoint
cards.explanation: Load Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS first. Use .actions containing btn btn-primary buttons. This overrides local component variables and stacks actions under 768px; no Bootstrap JavaScript needed.
keywords: stack bootstrap actions before a custom breakpoint

cards.title: Customize a Bootstrap button hover while retaining focus
cards.code:
.btn.local-action { --bs-btn-hover-bg:#14532d; --bs-btn-hover-border-color:#14532d; }
.btn.local-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #111827; outline-offset:2px; }
cards.explanation: Load Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS before this override; attach btn btn-primary local-action to a real button. Hover color and keyboard outline are separate states; verify contrast on the surrounding surface.
keywords: customize a bootstrap button hover while retaining focus

cards.title: Apply a Tailwind token with responsive and focus states
cards.explanation: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 input, compiled by the pinned CLI; do not serve raw directives. Use .recipe with two labelled buttons. @apply consumes utilities; @source keeps the explicit responsive utility available.
keywords: apply a tailwind token with responsive and focus states

cards.title: Use Tailwind motion variants without hiding status
cards.code:
@import "tailwindcss";
.pulse { @apply motion-safe:animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none; }
cards.explanation: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 input compiled with the local CLI. Use .pulse on decorative status text. Motion-safe and motion-reduce respond to the user preference; the words remain visible in both modes.
keywords: use tailwind motion variants without hiding status

cards.title: Shrink unequal flex bases proportionally
cards.explanation: Put wide and narrow empty-or-wrappable children in .shrink-row. Both shrink factors are one, but the larger 200px base absorbs twice the negative space of the 100px base. No gap, padding or border is assumed.

cards.title: Compare a wrapping minimum with an unwrapped maximum
cards.explanation: Use two blocks containing the same two words with a normal breakable space. min-content fits the longest word; max-content preserves the whole unwrapped line. An unbreakable identifier removes that distinction.
keywords: compare a wrapping minimum with an unwrapped maximum
